designer_notes: Jade Orb tutorial on a fat diamond (57 playable cells; a thin diamond would be too small for the plan's 44 dew). Tutorial swap: (3,3) blue <-> (3,4) red puts blue on (1,4),(2,4),(3,4),(4,4),(5,4): a 5-in-a-row on the widest row. Pins: (0,4) and (6,4) yellow so the line stops at 5; the cells above and below the line are green/yellow (no blue) so no L or T forms; (3,2) green and (3,5) green stop a red or blue vertical match through the swapped cells. A plus of 5 dew seeds sits on the centre, so the Orb line starts on dew. Goal OB04 x44 = plan value: 77% of 57 playable cells, 5 seeds (39 new cells). No familiar partner obstacle (plan lists only OB04); a one-goal easy level. Moves 28 = plan. [balance 2026-11-28] moves 28->26, goal 44->51 because bot 100% (est. human 100%, UNCALIBRATED) vs band 85-90 (cap 95). [redesign 2026-11-28] Board widened from 57 to 69 playable cells (rows 0-1 and 7-8 now 5 and 7 wide, rows 2-6 full 9 wide); goal 51->62 = 90% of 69 (cap), 5 seeds unchanged; more dew to spread with the same 26 moves. Hint cells (3,3),(3,4), pins and seeds unchanged; the 4 new cells in rows 2-6 outside the pins are random fill, none touch the row-4 line.
